title: [Bug] Message compacting fails with Anthropic API error on thinking block modification
body:
**Bug Description**
Message Compacting throws an Error: > /compact 
  ⎿ Error: Error during compaction: Error: API Error: 400 
    {"type":"error","error":{"type":"invalid_request_error","message":"messages.5.content.125: `thinking` or
     `redacted_thinking` blocks in the latest assistant message cannot be modified. These blocks must remain
     as they were in the original response."},"request_id":"req_011CVfEWZ8B1vqrHZUfnXvYC"} 

**Environment Info**
- Platform: linux
- Terminal: pycharm (phpstorm)
- Version: 2.0.55
- Feedback ID: ff84c6fe-811b-46ec-af4e-be6f6c97fb57
